author: Patrick Xjr
text:
Good afternoon
First the sensor doesn’t measure blood but interstitial liquid. You will have a delay of 15 mn between blood from finger (quicker) and sensor.
Then, sensor is very sensitive to its location on arm: if compressed, value is dropping very quickly. Normally you stick it at the rear of the arm. Check too during night : if dropping it is certainly because you sleep on your arm where you have the sensor. So next sensor put it on the other arm..

author: Peter Wilson
text: Sometimes my readings difference is way out eg my cgm might say 6 yet my blood is actually 9 that's too much of a difference, I find out sensors are always way out at first for several hours then Equalishes better, I accept a 1 difference to be normal. Also I have a stoma I find if I have a slow moving meal my reading is in the green range then as my food passes a certain point it shoots up my blood sugar, it's like a delayed reaction.
